name: SOLIDE INDOOR
description: The Solide Sauna blends contemporary sauna design with the natural beauty of wood and stone. Designed and produced by Harvia, the Solide combines the Finnish sauna experience with a traditional Scandinavian design. Beautiful tight-knot lumber is highlighted by black trim and accents, all enticingly visible through floor-to-ceiling glass. Up to six people can comfortably sit in the Solide Sauna, and the extra-wide and moveable benches provide comfortable and relaxed seating or reclining. The stone wall provides visual ambiance to the Solide Sauna, and the Harvia heater delivers exceptional steam when water is poured on the hot rocks. Bring the Finnish Sauna experience to your home with the beautiful Solide traditional sauna.
